verdict.rationale: The core engine is open source: libSQL is an MIT-licensed fork with a server mode, and the Turso embedded databases run entirely in-process with no server. A local libSQL server can also be started, and there is a bring-your-own-cloud option plus customer-owned S3 buckets. However, the documented local server is framed for development, and the platform features (multi-database provisioning, branching, PITR, MCP account management) are only evidenced as Turso Cloud features. Missing for 10: first-party docs for self-hosting a production server, evidence that platform features (branching, PITR, provisioning API) work self-hosted, BYOC available beyond Pro/Enterprise tiers, independent hands-on self-hosting reports.
